record.body:
## Evidence

expected: R7 / design invariant that the active write-policy constraint names the allowed dashboard write set (exclusive), while phase Non-goals keep existing backlog promote/dismiss.

observed: `dashboard-human-gate-writes` claims writes only for Needs-you clears; `dashboard/backlog.py` still promote/dismiss with `--expected-revision @current`.

severity: major

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Create a fix work-item under the retry budget to widen or clarify the constraint statement so backlog promote/dismiss remain in-policy without restoring blanket read-only.

payload.basis: dashboard-human-gate-writes says only Needs-you clears; backlog.py still supersedes with @current
payload.claim: spec-gap on approval-constraints: exclusive human-gate constraint wording conflicts with preserved backlog promote/dismiss writes
payload.invalidated_when: constraint statement names backlog promote/dismiss as allowed or exclusivity is clarified without contradicting Non-goals, and reviewer re-run passes
